scenes.headline: How BlenderWorld grades an editable 3D scene
scenes.sub: 223 Blender briefs, two judges, one opened project file
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Corbel! This benchmark hands an agent a design brief and takes back a Blender project. Here's how it grades it.

scenes.text: Send each requirement to the evidence that can settle it: fresh renders from eight angles for looks, and an agent inside the project file for structure.
scenes.mark: an agent inside the project file
scenes.say: One picture can lie. So looks are judged from eight fresh renders, and structure by an agent that opens the project file.

items.say: An agent reads the brief and builds the scene in Blender.
A second agent renders eight views of its choosing, fixing nothing.
A third opens the project and writes a script to measure it.
A vision judge scores what is visible, and rates eight qualities.

scenes.title: Every criterion goes to one judge

steps.say: Each task carries pass or fail criteria, weighted one, two or three.
More than half are about structure: sizes, materials, cameras, editability. Those go to the inspector.
The rest are about looks, and go to the vision judge.
The inspector checks the file and its own render. A criterion passes only if both pass.

scenes.title: One task score
scenes.say: Then the two halves are averaged.

parts.say: Half is the weighted share of criteria passed.
Half is ten times the mean of the eight quality ratings.

left.title: The agent's own check
left.say: The brief wanted wooden legs a hundred and fifty millimetres tall, on casters. One agent measured floor to frame, got a hundred and fifty, and stopped.

right.title: The inspector's check
right.say: The inspector measured the wood alone: a hundred and two. The leg criterion fails.

scenes.title: Score over 223 tasks
scenes.note: one run per agent, judged by GPT-5.6-terra
scenes.say: The best of thirteen agents scores about eighty, by the paper's count.

scenes.label: of tasks where the best agent passes every criterion
scenes.say: And even it passes every criterion on fewer than half the tasks.

scenes.text: The render can veto the file, and the file can veto the render. Looking right is not enough.
scenes.say: The thing to remember: the render can veto the file, and the file can veto the render.

recap: Eight fresh renders judge the looks
An agent opens the file for structure
Both must agree for a pass
scenes.say: Fresh renders for looks, an agent in the file for structure, and both must agree.
